crossRefs.note: Yahweh spoke with you face to face on the mountain out of the middle of the fire,
(I stood between Yahweh and you at that time, to show you Yahweh’s word; for you were afraid because of the fire, and…
When the sound of the trumpet grew louder and louder, Moses spoke, and God answered him by a voice.
Did a people ever hear the voice of God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as you have heard, and live?
Jacob called the name of the place Peniel; for he said, “I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.”
He said, “You cannot see my face, for man may not see me and live.”
Manoah said to his wife, “We shall surely die, because we have seen God.”

translations.web: and you said, “Behold, Yahweh our God has shown us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the middle of the fire. We have seen today that God does speak with man, and he lives.
translations.bsb: and you said, “Behold, the LORD our God has shown us His glory and greatness, and we have heard His voice out of the fire. Today we have seen that a man can live even if God speaks with him.
translations.kjv: And ye said, Behold, the LORD our God hath shewed us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire: we have seen this day that God doth talk with man, and he liveth.
translations.asv: and ye said, Behold, Jehovah our God hath showed us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire: we have seen this day that God doth speak with man, and he liveth.
